About.title: About Me
About.intro: My Name is Mahmoud Abu-Attiya but you can call me Mida. I'm a frontend developer who loves making intuitive and beautiful interfaces out of most complex problems. My specialization is in developing responsive, fast, and accessible web apps with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
About.motivation: What motivates me is writing clean code that works but also feels right in its use. Whether it's in a team setting or a feature build that I'm leading, I really care about seamless interfaces that take the experience to a step higher.
highlights: Built and launched several modern UIs with Next.js performance-oriented and scalable libraries.
Developed a digital menu platform for restaurants with dynamic theming, QR code generation, and item management capabilities.
Highly passionate about neat architecture, reusable components, and pixel-pushing precision.
I usually like to catch up on football, discover current UI trends, and learn something new to keep up with this fast-paced industry.
